howto: Choose Classic or the Daily blocks and press Play.
Tap one of the three blocks under the grid to pick it up.
Tap the grid: the block lands with its top-left corner on that square.
Fill a whole row or column to blast it. The game ends when none of your blocks fits.
tips: Blocks never rotate, so keep room for long bars and the big L.
Clearing lines on back-to-back moves builds a combo that multiplies the points.
Every clear charges the Blast meter; at 5 you get a bomb that wipes a 3x3 area.
Hint tries every block in every spot and shows a ghost where the best one goes.
Undo takes back your last drop, as often as you like.

controls.keyboard: 1, 2 or 3 picks a block, arrow keys move it, Enter drops it, Z undoes. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a block, then tap the grid. Undo, Hint and New Game sit under the tray.

difficulty: An adaptive curve: the first eight blocks are small, blocks get smaller again when the grid is crowded, and a new tray is re-rolled toward small pieces when nothing would fit.

cheats.effect: Bomb squad: a bomb joins your tray right now
Tiny blocks: every new block is 3 squares or fewer
Fresh tray: swap your blocks for three new ones

features.hints: Hint button (and Pause > Hint): tries every block in every spot, picks the drop that clears most and leaves the fewest gaps, and shows it as a ghost on the grid
features.undo: Undo button (or Z) takes back the last drop, any number of times
features.level-select-or-daily: Daily blocks on the title: everyone gets the same blocks in the same order today, with its own daily best
features.results: The grid shows GAME OVER with the run's points, clears and best combo in a card, and the score board updates
